reviewer: Claude Code (AI first-pass source audit; not an independent human curator)
scope: 1-based manifest positions 141-150 of data/validation/self_run_p0_candidates.json, frozen order; 10 candidates, 18 arms
blinding: self_run_p0_predictions.json and all model outputs were NOT opened. The FRDB snapshot /tmp/sisyphus-frdb-v2024-12-30.zip (SHA256 647b80d9...9c7a, verified) was read with every column containing 'cmax' dropped before any row was printed. Arms were mapped by dose, AUC, t1/2, n, sex and application/funbound comments only. Original-source Cmax values were then read from original tables or text. Epalrestat was mapped to its IF row by AUC 6435 ≈ FRDB 6.4 before its Cmax was read. The pseudohypericin abstract prints medians next to the doses, and mapping there is by dose content. No observed-vs-predicted comparison was made.
method_note: Single AI pass. Full originals read: PMC6986439 (sultiame, open access), Wiley Supporting Table S1 .doc for LY2409021/adomeglivant (freely downloadable supplement; main text paywalled), the current PMDA Cospanon IF _010 (flopropione; cited _008 URL is 404), and the PMDA Kinedak IF (epalrestat primary data; the manifest source is a secondary review). Closed originals were time-boxed to abstracts or landing pages: AHA Hypertension (VTP-27999, Cloudflare 403), DMD/Elsevier (PF-06282999, institutional access), J Clin Pharmacol/Wiley (naphthoquine), Xenobiotica/T&F (riodipine), ScienceDirect (meptazinol, Cloudflare 403), SAGE (pseudohypericin; abstract sufficient for ineligibility). Only PubMed E-utilities (via MCP), Europe PMC REST, publisher pages and PMDA were queried. No email, contact identifier or Unpaywall was used. Transient headless-browser files that this pass created in the gitignored .playwright-mcp/ were deleted; no repository file was modified.
unresolved_issues: Sultiame (1902): all 3 arms come from the open full text (explicit IR coated tablets, fasting, parent plasma, geometric means). 100 and 200 mg are verified. 50 mg is verified_with_caveat because its value (0.02 µg/mL) has 1-2 significant figures near the LLOQ. The candidate is still counted as 'with caveat' overall: n=4 and strongly nonlinear PK.

Flopropione (625): verified_with_caveat. Cmax is 'approximately 9 μg/mL' from the IF text/figure, with no statistic, at an off-label 240 mg dose in a conventional hard capsule. The cited IF version _008 is dead, so version _010 was read.

Adomeglivant (8372): all 3 arms map cleanly to Supporting Table S1 geometric means, but fasting state and dosage form are in the paywalled main text. Unverified pending library retrieval of doi 10.1111/dom.12446.
Epalrestat (428): ineligible. The manifest source is a review; the primary IF data were dosed 30 min before a meal, not fasted. The FRDB FASTED tag appears wrong.
Pseudohypericin (40814): all 3 arms ineligible. The dosed product is a multi-constituent Hypericum extract (LI 160), and the Cmax values are interim medians.

Naphthoquine (36941): unverified. The 400 mg NQP arm may be the monotherapy comparator or the naphthoquine component of the artemisinin FDC (ineligible). The dose is on a diphosphate-salt basis (≈271 mg base) while the manifest SMILES is the free base.
VTP-27999 (45237): unverified and likely ineligible. It is an MAD study in salt-depleted volunteers, and a day-1 single-dose Cmax, fasting and formulation are unconfirmed.
Riodipine (3504): unverified. This is a 14C capsule study with n=3, parent detectable only 2-6 h. The abstract's 0.41 µg-equiv/mL is total radioactivity, not parent.

Paywalled originals needing library retrieval: 10.1161/HYPERTENSIONAHA.113.02893 (VTP-27999), 10.1111/dom.12446 main text (adomeglivant fasting/formulation), 10.1177/0091270009356296 (naphthoquine), 10.1124/dmd.115.067868 Table 8 (PF-06282999), 10.3109/00498258509045049 (riodipine), 10.1016/j.jchromb.2009.08.051 (meptazinol).

arms.reason: The manifest source is a secondary review (Ramirez & Borja, Pharmacotherapy 2008), not an original PK study. The primary data are in the Japanese Kinedak interview form. Arm mapping uses FRDB AUC 6.4 µg·h/mL, which matches the IF's 6435 ng·h/mL for the pre-meal arm, and n=10. In that arm, healthy adults took a single 50 mg dose 30 minutes BEFORE a meal (食前30分), which matches the labelled 'before each meal' regimen. It is not a fasted-state administration: the meal falls within the absorption phase (Tmax about 1 h). Under the prior convention (anagliptin premeal arms), this is ineligible. The IF also reports a separate post-meal arm.

arms.reason: The original studies 'compound naphthoquine phosphate' (ARCO), a fixed-dose combination of naphthoquine phosphate and artemisinin (1:2.5). The abstract also mentions a monotherapy comparison: the combination raised naphthoquine AUC by 135% versus monotherapy. The FRDB arm (400 mg, AUC 424 µg·h/L, n=10, t1/2 298.6 h) is plausibly the naphthoquine phosphate monotherapy arm, since 955/2.35 ≈ 406. It could also be the naphthoquine component of the 1400 mg FDC (400 mg NQP + 1000 mg artemisinin), which would be ineligible as a multi-ingredient product. The full text is paywalled, so arm identity, formulation and Cmax could not be confirmed. Dose-basis caveat: 400 mg is naphthoquine PHOSPHATE, a diphosphate salt (MW 605.9) whose free base is MW 409.9 (≈271 mg base). The FRDB analyte label is the phosphate salt, and the manifest SMILES is the free base.

arms.reason: The original is a [14C]ryosidine (riodipine) mass-balance and metabolism study with oral CAPSULE dosing in humans. Mapping uses the abstract's unchanged-drug t1/2 of 80 min, which matches FRDB t1/2 80 min, and FRDB n=3 men. Unchanged drug was detected only 2-6 h post-dose and made up ≤5% of plasma 14C. The abstract gives only the total-14C peak of 0.41 µg-equiv/mL, which must NOT be used as parent Cmax. The parent Cmax, fasting state and exact dose are in the paywalled full text. The abstract says the capsule dosage form limited absorption. The capsule is presumably conventional but is unconfirmed.

For the record, the abstract's median pseudohypericin Cmax is 2.7 ng/mL.

arms.reason: Mapped by dose 240 mg, n=12 and healthy men (FRDB carries no AUC or t1/2). The IF text gives unchanged flopropione plasma Cmax after a single fasted oral dose of six Cospanon 40 mg hard capsules. Caveats: Cmax is stated only as 'approximately 9 μg/mL' (約9μg/mL), read from a figure, with no statistic (mean vs individual) or dispersion. 240 mg is 3-6× the approved 40-80 mg dose (IF footnote). The capsule is a conventional hard capsule, not labelled IR. The manifest URL (IF version _008) now returns 404, so the current IF version _010 (Feb 2024, 9th ed.) was read. It carries the same study, and equivalence of wording with _008 is assumed, not checked.
